title: Compiled Objective
description: The output of the objective-compilation skill: one Objective decomposed into a validated Work Item graph, ready for graph.ts to apply to GitHub as sub-issues and native 'blocked by' dependencies. Before issue creation, Factory stores this complete artifact under an immutable per-run GitHub custom ref so crash recovery can replay it without recompilation.

title.description: The Objective issue's title, unchanged from the human-authored Objective (§4's Objective is read, not rewritten, by the loop).

workItems.description: Every Work Item this Objective decomposes into. Readiness is derived from each item's `dependsOn`; Factory also receipts the original order solely to reconstruct an identical graph digest after interruption.
